evidence: Name the eligible completed CTS courses and the exact skills this project extends. Connect at least two successfully completed eligible courses, including an intermediate Tourism course. Suggested connections: TOU2010 and TOU2070. Actual event-facilitation requirements remain a separate validation issue. Record the teacher's eligibility/proposal confirmation reference, or explicitly state that confirmation is pending.

Create a proposal for an event visitor-information system containing an original site diagram, three signs, a role handover and a feedback instrument; do not resubmit the TOU2010 event plan as the project Include audience, purpose, boundaries, original deliverables, success criteria and resources.
Create a milestone plan and maintain a dated external project log. Summarize the main dependencies, effort and changes here.

Produce the original deliverable and retain draft/final versions. Run three solo visitor walkthroughs using different information needs, record confusing points and revise the system. Do not claim actual participants or facilitation.
List your evidence files or references, research sources and dates, testing observations and permission notes. Each project must have its own distinct learning and evidence.
Evaluate the result against the proposal, explain one justified revision, and connect a developed skill with a future learning or work goal.
